_comment: Defaults for crap-gate.py and mutation.py; a repo overrides them in .claude/quality-gates.json "limits". ccn_max 10: ruff mccabe and golangci-lint cyclop default 10. crap_max 30: crap4j's initial threshold (artima thread 215899). manual_wait_seconds: the limit shown while mutate-request holds the reviewer, the timeout of that hook entry in agents/code-reviewer.md (1800).
